notes: FleetComm no longer closes for an update on faith. On one machine, Windows was killing the update installer the instant it started — the app had already closed, so the update simply never happened, with nothing to show for it. Now the installer proves it is actually running before FleetComm exits. If it is killed, FleetComm relaunches it through the Windows Task Scheduler, which runs it out of reach of what killed it the first time. And if that is blocked too, FleetComm stays open and tells you exactly that, instead of closing into nothing.
